subject.title: Rowland Unified School District Board, Trustee Area 5

text: My name is Dr. Kevin T. Hayakawa. I'm a Cal State Physics Professor and NASA Principal Investigator. As a professor, I train the next generation of doctors, scientists, and engineers. I’m running for re-election to the Rowland Unified School District Board of Education this November. Serving on the school board over the past 4 years has been one of the greatest honors of my life. Rowland Unified isn’t just the district I represent—it’s the district that raised me.

But let me cut to the chase: I’m just as surprised as you are that you live within the boundaries of Rowland Unified School District. In fact, 99.8% of RUSD residents live in Los Angeles County, specifically within the cities of La Puente, Industry, Rowland Heights, Walnut, and West Covina. You are part of the elite 0.2% of RUSD residents that live in Orange County. In fact, if you’re reading this, then you probably live in either north Brea or La Habra on Alwick Place, Midbury Street, Oak Dyke Avenue, North Puente Street, or Wesham Place.

To all of my OC constituents, I just want to say that I completely support allowing north Brea families to send their children to local schools within Brea-Olinda Unified School District such as Mariposa Elementary School, Falcon Academy of Science & Technology, Brea Junior High School, and Brea Olinda High School.

I also support allowing La Habra families to send their children to local schools within Fullerton Joint Union High School District, and La Habra City School District such as Arbolita Elementary School, Ladera Palma Elementary School, Sierra Vista Elementary School, Washington Middle School, La Habra High School, and Sonora High School.
RUSD K–12 Graduate: Ybarra Academy, Telesis Academy, and Rowland High School,
Bachelor’s degrees in Physics and Astrophysics from UC Berkeley,
Master’s degree in Astronomy from UCLA,
Ph.D. in Astronomy and Astrophysics from UCLA,

11+ years of teaching experience in all three segments of California's public higher education system: the University of California (UC), the California State University (CSU), and the California Community Colleges (CCC),
5+ years of local government experience at both the school district and water district,
Vote Dr. Kevin T. Hayakawa for Rowland Unified School District Board of Education!

statement.disclaimer: Statements are volunteered by the candidates and have not been checked for accuracy by any official agency.
